limitations: Same Windows GPU for both profiles; constrained flags are app budget emulation, not physical iPad performance.
Main JS heap excludes worker heaps, ArrayBuffer/WASM backing stores, GPU and OS RSS.
Geography is cached; other network and scheduling variations remain. Actor poses are not time-locked.
Initial warmup excluded; input mismatch pairs preserved with run=-2 and repeated. Triangle hash normalizes storage/cyclic order without coordinate tolerance.
LOD source-buffer saving is measured separately; both scene arms include shared bounded LOD attributes and worker release fixes.
All scene algorithms are not ported: Earcut triangulation, road simulation, terrain sampling and articulated walkers/wheels remain JS.
